Overview

Killeen is a city in TX with a population of 155,000. Central Texas city with Fort Hood and a strong military community. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
